gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Builds an unescaper with no options. Per the CUT, an empty option array defaults to {@code OPTION.semiColonRequired}, so entities without a terminating ';' are
ADDED i3: Wraps the given chars in a CharBuffer and translates it. The buffer is usually longer than the meaningful prefix, so the unused cells keep their default value '
ADDED i4: "" is a complete decimal entity terminated by ';', so it is unescaped to code point 2 (U+0002); the three trailing null cells pass through.
ADDED i5: "&#X;" has no digits after the hex marker, so parsing fails and the "&#X;" prefix is emitted verbatim along with the trailing null cells.
ADDED i6: The entity "&#3" starts at index 4, but is incomplete (no ';') and too close to the end for the CUT's "&#" look-ahead, so nothing is translated.
ADDED i7: "&#X" without a semicolon is not unescaped under the default semiColonRequired option and is echoed back with the trailing nulls.
ADDED i8: "&#x" (lowercase hex marker) with no digits is left unchanged, mirroring the uppercase case above, here within a longer buffer.
ADDED i9: A lone '&' followed only by null cells is not an entity, so the input is returned unchanged.
ADDED i10: A single-character buffer containing just '&' has nothing after it to form an entity, so it is returned as-is.
ADDED i11: Constructing with a non-null option array that contains a null element fails when the CUT copies it into an EnumSet.
ADDED i13: The incomplete entity "&#X" appears at index 3 of the buffer; it is not translated, and both the leading nulls and the "&#X" suffix are preserved.
